How few particles can be sampled while preserving class counts?

ML labels are fixed. Random estimates are medians from 1,000 samples without replacement.

The time-series view is restricted to 5%. The shaded band is the random-sampling 5th-95th percentile envelope.
Each retained percentage has separate random and sequential log-log scatterplots. Colour identifies class, and the grey diagonal is perfect agreement.
Logarithmic axes require positive values. 2,363 non-positive true/subsampled count pairs were omitted from the scatterplots.
